sources.entry: noswoosh - Instant, animation-free switching between macOS Spaces with a 3-finger swipe or Ctrl+arrow keys.

summary.one_liner: noswoosh is a macOS daemon that makes switching between Spaces instant and animation-free, triggered by a 3-finger horizontal swipe or Ctrl+←/→.
summary.what_it_does: It intercepts real 3-finger horizontal trackpad swipes and replaces them with an instant space switch, leaving vertical swipes (Mission Control, App Exposé) alone. It also binds Ctrl+←/→ to switch one space left or right. Switching is clamped at the first and last space so there is no rubber-band bounce. It synthesizes a Dock-swipe gesture with near-zero progress and high velocity so the switch goes through the Dock's own pipeline. It includes a CLI (list, left, right, setup, teardown, version) for scripting and hotkey tools. The README also documents a workaround for a macOS behavior where landing on an empty desktop yanks the user to another space.
use_cases: switch macOS Spaces without slide animation
bind a hotkey to move between Spaces
script Spaces switching from the command line
stop Ctrl+arrow desktop switching from animating
how_to_run: Grant Accessibility permission to /Applications/noswoosh.app when prompted (or add it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility)
Build from source: git clone the repo, cd noswoosh, ./scripts/install.sh
notable: Zero-travel synthetic Dock-swipe gesture makes space switches instant without disabling SIP
Separate code paths for macOS 26 and macOS 27 due to the 27 IOHID payload requirement
Works without the global Reduce Motion setting, which is a crossfade rather than a cut
Includes a fix for the empty-desktop yank that keeps Dock-icon-follow working
Ctrl+arrow hotkey keeps working even if the swipe event tap is disabled
caveats: Not supported on macOS 26.0–26.5; requires 26.6 or later
Relies on undocumented private APIs that any macOS release may break
Requires granting Accessibility permission, which cannot be scripted
Building from source requires Xcode Command Line Tools
